title_ar: واجهة مجموعة متحف المتروبوليتان وسياسة الوصول المفتوح (CC0)
rights_jurisdiction: US (CC0 waiver applies worldwide to Met's own rights)
title: The Met Collection API and Open Access policy (public-domain images, CC0)
key_findings: The Met offers >406,000 public-domain images under its Open Access policy (launched Feb 2017), usable without restriction under CC0; the collection metadata is also CC0.
API: /public/collection/v1.1/search (paginated; the old /v1/search was retired on 1 Oct 2026) + /v1/objects/{id}; the isPublicDomain flag marks Open Access images; no API key; ~80 req/s limit.
Images of works the Met knows to be in copyright are licensed separately via Art Resource and are NOT in Open Access.
W2-IMAGES stored 182 Met Open Access images; W2-GULF-IMAGES added 20 more (total 202) (Islamic art objects, 19th-c. photographs of Arab cities, prints, European instruments).
athar_applications: Primary legal source of object props: astrolabes, padlocks/keys, seals, coins/weights, inkwells, pen boxes, calligraphy, al-Jazari automata folios, mashrabiya, tiles.
19th-c. photographs (Du Camp, Salzmann, Bonfils, Frith, Girault de Prangey) give period city views of Cairo, Damascus, Baalbek, Beirut.
limitations: CC0 covers copyright only; cultural sensitivity (sacred texts, religious objects) is ATHAR's own filter.
Object photographs are museum studio shots: they need art direction (cut-outs, aging) before use as in-game props.
The v1.1 search returns relevance-ranked hits that include off-topic objects; manual review is required.

title_ar: مجموعة ماتسون الفوتوغرافية (قسم التصوير في المستعمرة الأمريكية بالقدس) — مكتبة الكونغرس
rights_jurisdiction: US: no known restrictions (rights dedicated to the American public in 2003); UK/EU & Arab states: anonymous/corporate work terms (70/50 years from making) expired for items made by 1946
license: 'No known restrictions on publication' (LoC rights advisory)
title: G. Eric and Edith Matson Photograph Collection (American Colony Photo Department) — Library of Congress, with P&P rights statement
publisher: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division
key_findings: LoC P&P rights statement: 'No known restrictions'; the Kensington Episcopal Home conveyed the collection in 1978 and in 2003 dedicated its IP rights to the American public, subject to any rights previously conveyed.
Only exception noted: a book-form limit of 25 lantern slides tied to an Overlook Press book; irrelevant to digital props from glass negatives.
Requested credit line: 'Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division, [reproduction number]'.
Collection background page: created by the American Colony Photo Department and successor Matson Photo Service; place names reflect 1898-1946.

W2-IMAGES stored 78 images (Tripoli & El-Mina, Damascus streets/courtyards/souqs, Aleppo citadel, Beirut, Sidon, Hama norias, Baghdad area, Basra, Mosul, Cairo, Jaffa, Amman, Petra, craft workshops, manuscripts).
athar_applications: Core historic-city reference set for the fictional cities (al-Qantara, al-Atlal) and for 'Dhakirat al-Hay' oral-history cases (period photographs as evidence).
Craft-workshop photographs (potters, glass-blowers, weavers, scribes) support the 'artisan witness' character pattern.
limitations: Created inside a colonial-era/missionary-adjacent studio: framing and captions carry an outsider gaze; captions contain dated terms — re-caption in ATHAR's own words.
Many stereographs (double frames) need cropping.

42 stored items may date after 1930 and are tagged rights_review:post1930 (residual EU risk if an individual author is ever identified). [Corrected 2026-10-27 by deep-card review: IMAGE_ASSET_REGISTER.csv has 42 such rows, not 43.]

rights_jurisdiction: US (published >95 years ago); worldwide (anonymous corporate works >100 years old)
title: Photochrom Prints collection (Detroit Publishing Co. / Photoglob Zürich) — Library of Congress, with rights statement
publisher: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division
key_findings: LoC rights statement: 'No known restrictions'; photochroms were published mainly 1890s-1910s; US-published items >95 years old are PD; no known restrictions on Photoglob items.
W2-IMAGES stored 23 colour views of Cairo, Damascus (incl. a Damascene house interior and Straight Street), Beirut, Baalbek, Jaffa, Algiers, Constantine, Tunis souqs, Biskra.
athar_applications: Colour palette reference for the 'old paper / copper / lapis' visual identity; postcard-style props (e.g., a tourist postcard as a dating clue).
limitations: Photochroms are hand-coloured transfers; colours are not documentary evidence of real colours.
Tourist-market imagery with orientalist staging; avoid 'type' portraits (removed in review).

AUDIT-W2 2026-10-27: item-level rights advisories are not uniform: of the 23 stored photochroms, 17 carry 'No known restrictions on publication.' but 6 Maghreb items (IMG-0380...0385) carry 'No known restrictions on reproduction.' (LoC JSON API, 2026-10-27). Register strings for those 6 corrected; PD reasoning unchanged. The verification_url (guides.loc.gov anchor) no longer renders the collection statement; the item JSON (?fo=json) is the reliable source.

title_ar: مجموعة السلطان عبد الحميد الثاني الفوتوغرافية — مكتبة الكونغرس
license: 'There are no known restrictions on material in this collection' (LoC)
title: Abdul Hamid II Collection (Ottoman albums, 1880-1893) — Library of Congress, with rights statement
publisher: Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division
key_findings: LoC rights statement: publication permitted; no known restrictions.
W2-IMAGES stored 5 images (Ottoman school façades incl. the Damascus imperial high school, public fountains, Grand Bazaar exterior).
athar_applications: Late-Ottoman institutional architecture for 'Dar al-Sijill' and school-based cases.
limitations: Albums were presented as state self-representation; portraits of pupils were excluded from storage (identifiable minors).

title_ar: مجموعة ويلكم — واجهة الفهرس وسياسة ترخيص الصور
license: per item: Public Domain Mark / CC0 / CC BY 4.0 (NC items excluded)
title: Wellcome Collection — catalogue API and image licensing/credit policy (PDM, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-NC)
key_findings: Wellcome uses PDM (out of copyright), CC BY (credit as stipulated), CC BY-NC and CC BY-NC-ND per item; the source credit should be 'Wellcome Collection'; CC BY attribution should name work, source and licence.
Wellcome states it is usually not the copyright holder and digitisation did not make it one; Burroughs Wellcome & Co. material is GSK copyright.
The images API supports a licence filter (locations.license=pdm,cc-0,cc-by) and IIIF delivery (!1600,1600).

W2-IMAGES stored 50 curated images: Galton 'Finger prints' (1892) plates, Faulds 'Dactylography' charts, Bertillon instruction plates (measurement procedure, ear/iris charts; no mugshots), 18th-19th-c. laboratories, Hooke Micrographia plates, Arabic/Persian medical & astronomical manuscripts, a cipher comparison chart (1807).
athar_applications: History-of-forensics explainer visuals for Lab #1 (fingerprints) and the 'limits of identification' narrative (Bertillon → fingerprints).
Lab-interior and glassware references for the 'al-Manzar' lab; cipher chart for code-breaking mechanics.
limitations: Licences vary per image: always use the register's licence field; many Galton/Faulds photographs are CC BY (attribution mandatory).
Bertillon albums include mugshot plates of real arrested persons — deliberately NOT stored (teen safety + dignity).

title_ar: ويكيميديا كومنز — واجهة البرمجة وبيانات الترخيص لكل ملف
license: per file: Public domain / CC0 / CC BY x / CC BY-SA x (only these accepted by W2-IMAGES)
title: Wikimedia Commons — MediaWiki API (imageinfo/extmetadata) and file licensing as recorded per file
key_findings: Commons' licensing policy page describes it as an official policy giving non-lawyers an overview of what media are acceptable (free licences / PD only).

Each file's extmetadata exposes LicenseShortName, Artist, Credit, UsageTerms, Restrictions; W2-IMAGES accepted only PD/CC0/PDM/CC BY/CC BY-SA, skipped files with 'Restrictions' (personality/trademark/insignia), and required a PD-* template for 'Public domain' files.
The API and upload.wikimedia.org throttled this client (HTTP 429 with Retry-After); harvest used ≥4-7 s spacing and thumbnail URLs.
W2-IMAGES stored 48 Commons files (al-Idrisi Tabula Rogeriana copies, Tripoli khans/citadel, Azm Palace, Khan As'ad Pasha, Aleppo citadel/souq, Beirut, Byblos, and further sites — see register).
athar_applications: Contemporary photographs of extant heritage sites (khans, souqs, madrasas, wind towers) — the only open source with good Gulf coverage.
limitations: Commons licence claims are uploader assertions; Commons itself warns reusers to verify. CC BY-SA imposes share-alike on adaptations (see 11/rights_rules.csv: conditional for commercial ATHAR use).
Photos of modern buildings may be subject to freedom-of-panorama limits in some Arab countries (UAE/Qatar etc.) — not cleared here; flag for W2-LEGAL.

title_ar: النصوص القانونية لتراخيص المشاع الإبداعي وعلامة الملك العام وممارسات الإسناد الموصى بها
title: Creative Commons licence legal codes (CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 4.0, CC0 1.0), Public Domain Mark 1.0 and 'Recommended practices for attribution' (TASL)
key_findings: CC recommends attribution by TASL: Title, Author, Source, Licence (title optional for 4.0 licences).
PDM 1.0 deed: the work is identified as free of known copyright restrictions, but may not be free in all jurisdictions, and other rights (trademark, publicity, privacy, moral rights) may persist.
CC BY-SA 4.0 requires adapted material to be shared under the same or a compatible licence.
CC0 1.0 waives copyright and related rights to the extent possible; no attribution required (credit still good practice).
athar_applications: Defines the attribution strings in VISUAL_REFERENCE_GUIDE.md and the share-alike quarantine rule for CC BY-SA assets.
limitations: CC is not a law firm; licence application to Arab jurisdictions has not been tested in court (see 11_RIGHTS_PRIVACY_AND_SAFETY).
Overlap: W2-LEGAL catalogs the CC BY-SA 4.0 legal code separately (ATH-SRC-1839) and wave 1 the CC BY-NC 4.0 code (ATH-SRC-1025); merge step may de-duplicate.

title_ar: علم البصمات: التصنيف والاستخدامات (دليل مكتب التحقيقات الفيدرالي)
rights_jurisdiction: US (17 U.S.C. §105 — works of the US Government are not eligible for copyright); outside US not formally established
title: The Science of Fingerprints: Classification and Uses (FBI manual, 1957 printing) — Internet Archive scan
authors: United States. Federal Bureau of Investigation
key_findings: IA metadata: creator 'United States. Federal Bureau of Investigation', 1957, 230 page images, no licence stated; also mirrored as Project Gutenberg eBook #19022.
17 U.S.C. §105: copyright protection is not available for works of the US Government (verified on LII).
W2-IMAGES stored 9 diagram pages (pattern area, deltas, loops, ridge-count diagram, specimen grid, a 'questionable patterns' page, fingerprinting stand).
athar_applications: Ready-made, anonymous fingerprint pattern diagrams for Lab #1 tutorials; ATHAR must still generate synthetic prints for actual puzzles.
limitations: Mid-century doctrine: presents classification as near-infallible — pair with modern error-rate evidence (ATH-SRC-0331/0332).
Specimen prints are real but anonymous; no names or faces.

rights_jurisdiction: US (pre-1931); life+70 UK/EU (author d. 1931 → expired end-2001); life+50 Arab states
title: Classification and Uses of Finger Prints (E. R. Henry, 1900) — Internet Archive scan (Google Books / University of California)
key_findings: IA metadata marks the scan NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT; publisher George Routledge & Sons, 1900; author dates 1850-1931 per catalog records.
W2-IMAGES stored 5 diagram pages (delta/core diagrams, twinned-loop figure, ridge tracing, classification grid).
athar_applications: Historical-method explainer: how a filing system made fingerprint search scale (systems thinking, not only 'matching').
limitations: Developed for colonial policing in Bengal; any narrative use must present this context critically.
Book also describes criminal-case anecdotes — use diagrams only.

title_ar: مكتبة الكونغرس — معلومات الحقوق والقيود لمجموعات الصور
title: Library of Congress Prints & Photographs — Rights and Restrictions Information (collection-level rights statements dataset)
authors: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division
key_findings: The guide loads a CSV of collection-level statements (access, reproduction, publication, credit line, privacy).
LoC states it does not own rights and cannot grant/deny permission; researchers must assess rights.
Bain and Harris & Ewing collections: no known copyright restrictions but publicity/privacy rights of depicted people may apply — relevant to any future portrait use (W2-IMAGES stored none).
athar_applications: Rights-verification workflow for any future LoC asset: check collection statement + item rights_advisory (both done for every stored LoC image).
limitations: Collection-level statements can have item exceptions; the item 'rights_advisory' field was checked for each image.

title_ar: الوصول المفتوح لمتحف كليفلاند للفنون (CC0) — مصدر مرشّح
title: Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access (CC0) and public API — 12 images stored by W2-GULF-IMAGES
key_findings: CMA releases Open Access images and data under CC0; a public API needs no key.
API probe (2026-10-27): 'Islamic manuscript' 167 CC0 hits, 'Syria' 156; 'astrolabe' 0.
W2-GULF-IMAGES stored 12 CMA CC0 images (Arabian Peninsula/Maghreb objects) — see IMAGE_ASSET_REGISTER.csv.
athar_applications: Next-wave supplement for manuscript folios and textiles if Met coverage is insufficient.
limitations: Not harvested in this wave (quota/time); many hits are figurative court paintings needing cultural review.

title_ar: قاعدة بيانات NIST الخاصة 302 للبصمات — مُفهرسة دون تخزين
title: NIST Special Database 302 (Nail to Nail fingerprint challenge dataset) — cataloged, NOT stored
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
key_findings: Data from a Sept 2017 IARPA N2N collection: rolled, plain, palm and latent impressions from study participants; distributed via NIST's dataset request site.
Page notes review by the NIST Research Protection Office; no licence/use terms stated on the page — biometric data of real people.
athar_applications: Do not use real biometric data in a teen product; ATHAR should synthesise fingerprints. Cite SD 302 only as evidence of how realistic latent datasets look.
limitations: Terms on the request site not reviewed; biometric data = special-category personal data under several Arab PDP laws (see 11/).

title_ar: أساسنز كريد ميراج — ميزة «تاريخ بغداد» التعليمية (مرجع بصري برابط فقط)
title: Assassin's Creed Mirage — 'History of Baghdad' educational codex (Ubisoft) — link-only visual reference
key_findings: Codex of 66 historical sites with research articles on five themes (economy, belief & daily life, government, art & science, court life), illustrated with captioned photographs of real caliphal-period artefacts.
Partners named: David Collection, Institut du monde arabe, Khalili Collections, Shangri La Museum of Islamic Art; historian Dr Glaire D. Anderson (Edinburgh).
athar_applications: Benchmark for pairing play with museum-credited artefact images — the same pattern ATHAR can follow with Met/Wellcome assets (credit line per image).
limitations: Action game with violence (assassination) — style reference only, never content; no screenshots stored.

title_ar: بيت الحكمة (استوديو لوناسي، 2026) — مرجع بصري برابط فقط
title: The House of Hikmah (Lunacy Studios, 2026) — link-only visual reference
key_findings: Steam lists developer/publisher Lunacy Studios, release 8 Apr 2026, a voice-acted narrative 3D adventure about grief and legacy.

Arab News (Pakistan edition) reports it is set in the House of Wisdom with seven historical scholars (incl. Ibn al-Haytham, Ibn Sina, Fatima al-Fihri), each level built around one discipline (e.g., optics).
athar_applications: Closest visual/thematic neighbour to ATHAR's 'al-Manzar' lab concept — study to differentiate (ATHAR: contemporary settings, evidence reasoning, non-fantasy).
limitations: Press claims not independently verified; no screenshots stored.
